buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PREQUALIFYING REQUIREMENT FOR TENDER · The bidder must have supplied the material mentioned in the price bid or same type of material elsewher e in the UPPTCL/ Govt. utility. · Bidder must be registered with GST. · Bidder must be registered with ESIC Department. · Bidder must be registered with E.P.F Department. · Bidder must be registered in Labour department Of Uttar Pradesh Government. · Bidder must have past experience of same/similar services & must provide details of similar work in UPPT CL/Power Grid/state transmission corporation and completion certificate for reference, failing which the bid is liable to be rejected. · The firm should have past experience of supplying of same material to UPPTCL/PSU/Government Dept. du ring last 05 year ending last day of month previous to the one in which applications are invited should be either of the following :- Three similar completed work/service not less than the amount equal to 40% of the estimated cost . Or

Two similar completed work/service not less than the amount equal to 50% of the estimated cost. Or. One similar completed work/service not less than the amount equal to 80% of the estimated cost. · Copy of latest Income Tax clearance certificate/Return filed and PAN Card. · Class (A) category electrical license certificate of Uttar Pradesh Government. · No Joint Venture is acceptable. · Bidder must submit the character certificate issued by District magistrate valid on the date of bid submiss ion. · MAAT :- Average annual financial turnover during the last 03 years, ending 31st March 2025, should be at least 100% (Minimum) of the estimated cost. It must be C.A. Certified (With UDIN No.). · Solvency Certificate :- Bidder must submit Solvency Certificate issued by Bank. · If rates quoted by the firm are below 10% then, 5% @ 0.5% for up to 10% and 1% for each percent above 10% of estimated value, additional B.G./Performance guarantee will be taken in the form of FDR/TDR only. The contractor shall be submit additional security/performance guarantee as per U.P. Govt. order no. 622/ 23-122021-2 audit /08 T.C.-2 dated 08-06-2012 which was adopted in its 53rd BOD meeting of U.P. Power T ransmission on dated 27.06.2017 before agreement, as applicable. · Bidder must have past experience of same/similar services & must provide details of similar work/Supply i n UPPTCL/Power Grid/state transmission corporation and completion certificate for reference, failing which the bid is liable to be rejected. · The bidder should not have been blacklisted or disqualified for non-performance in any of the Gov ernment utilities in the past Five Years as on the date of bid opening and bidder shall furnish self- d eclaration to this effect on a non- judicial stamp of Rs. 10/- failing which the bid is liable to be rejec ted. NOTE: · All the documents should be self-attested · Bidder shall have to submit the documentary evidence in support of above pre-qualifying requirement. SPECIAL TERM & CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT 1 -Scope of Work: - The scope of services to be provided by contractor for Repairing and calibration of Thermoscanning Ca mera at 400 kV Substation Pali Greater Noida. 2 -T & P:- All T & P required for proper execution of works shall be arranged by the con tractor himself, at his own cost. 3- LABOUR: - Gardeners & skilled labours for said work shall be arranged by the contractor at his own cost. In this connection department does not take any responsibility. However, person deployed by the contractor found including in the act of uni on, indiscipline or anything objectionable, shall be removed from site if aske d to do so by engineer. 4- ELECTRICITY RULE: - All construction work shall be carried out as per relevant provision of Indian E lectricity Rule 1956 and Indian Electricity Act. 1910 or any amendment there

of. Technical specification of the contract and any other manual referred to t herein shall be strictly adhered to. 5- SAFETY & WORKMANSHIP: - All safety rules shall be strictly observed by the contractor during the entire period of execution of work. However, in case of any major or minor accident, the contractor shall be who lly responsible for all consequences arising thereof including payment of com pensation under ‘Workers’ compensation Act and the department shall in no way be responsible of this. JE & AE shall ensure that at no level the safety rul ed are violated. 6- MATERIAL: - All required material for carried out the work shall be provided by the Contractor at his own cost. 7- THEFT & LOSSES: - In case of any theft and losses of material, reported by security guard / Contractor, necessary FIR shall be lodged by concerned JE with the concerning Police Station. 8- INSURANCE: - The responsibility to maintain adequate insurance coverage at all times during period of contract for s afety of staff deployed and spares handed over for maintenance shall be that of contractor. The contra ctor shall also take necessary insurance to indemnity third party risk arising out of work to be done by him at his own cost. The department shall not be responsible in any way in case of any mishappening. The contractor shall provide with copy of all insurance policies & documents to Executive Engineer. 9- SUPERVISION: - All work shall be supervised by Assistant Engineer/ JE shall be over all in charge of supervision of each & every work in the contract. JE entrusted to get the work done, shall personally ensures that the exec ution is done exclusively as per specification of contract. In case of any deviation, he will immediately write to contractor under intimation to Assistant Engineer/ Engineer in Charge. 10- ENGINEER: - Executive Engineer, Electricity 400KV S/S Division, UPPTCL, Greater Noida shall be Engineer of the cont ract. 11- VERIFICATION OF BILLS: - After the work has been satisfactorily completed the work Contractor will submit bill to concerned JE / AE for recording in MB and verification. Any delay beyond that shall have to be justified by JE&AE in th e covering letter. There should not be any substantial gap between the date of verification of bills in M B and its submission in the office of EE. 12- DISPUTE: - In case of any dispute in respect of interpretation of any provision in the contract of any nature in resp ect of the work, the decision of the superintending engineer, Electricity Transmission circle, UPPTCL, Gr eater Noida shall be final & binding upon both the parties. 13- JURISDICTION OF COURT: - The contract shall be governed by the Law of Government of India for the time in force in District Gaut am Buddh Nagar in the state of U.P. and shall be under the jurisdiction of Hon’ble High Court, Allahaba d. No other court shall have jurisdiction to entertain the same. 14- PENALTY: - The Contractor shall have to executive execute the above work within stipulated time allowed, failing which a penalty @ ½% per week on remaining work subject to maximum of 10% of amount of the wor k shall be levied and recovered from the contractor’s bills. 15 -FINANCIAL CONDITIONS a. PRICE: - To be quoted on rate schedule enclosed. b. DAMAGE OF EQUIPMENT: - The contractor shall ensure to follow all instructions issued by conce rned AE/JE. Incase damage of any equipment, if it is found due to negligence of contractor’s employee/ labour, same shall be recovered from contractor’s bill.

16-STATUTORY DUTIES AND TAXES:- a. LOCAL TAXES AND LEVIES: - GST will be charge as per applicable. b. INCOME TAX: - The contractor shall be liable and responsible for payment of such taxes if attracted under the provision of law. 17- EARNEST MONEY & SECURITY DEPOSIT: - a) The Contractor shall furnish security @ 1% of total value of the contract on start of work otherwis e shall be deducted from 1st running bill. The amount of Earnest money will be converted into secu rity deposit. b) The security money shall be released after 6 months from the date of successful completion of wo rk. c) The security money shall be forfeited either in whole or in part at the absolute discretion of the e ngineer, if the contractor fails or neglect to observe or perform any his obligation under the contra ct. 18-COMPLETION PERIOD: Period for this work shall be for 60 days/2 months from the date of agreement /availability of shut down. 19-TERMS OF PAYMENT: - a) 90% payment on monthly basis shall be made after submission of bills and 100% payment may b e released on submission of CDR/FDR of 10% amount of monthly bill. b) Balance 10% payment or FDR/CDR of 10% amount shall be withheld as performance guarantee an d shall be released after 6 months period from the date of completion of work after necessary certi fication by JE/AE that the work has been completed satisfactorily as per specification and nothing is outstanding against the contractor against this agreement or any other agreement of Dn. 20 -MODE OF PAYMENT: - a) All payment shall be made through RTGS 21 -WITH HOLDING OF PAYMENT: - The payment can be withheld on account of following at the discretion of engineer a) Violation of any contractual obligation on part of the contractor. b) Failure by the contractor to make due payment of material or labour employed by him. c) In sufficient progress of work. When the grounds for withholding the payments are removed, payme nt shall be made without any delay. 23- NOTICE TO CONTRACTOR: - Any notice may be given to the contractor, if the Corporation thinks fit by the Registered post on the a ddress given by contractor. Apart from terms and conditions mentioned above provisions contained in General Conditi ons of Contract “A” of UPPTCL shall also be applicable. However, in case of any discrepancy pr ovisions mentioned in general terms & conditions and special conditions will prevail over of form A con ditions. .
